description: IReservationBroker.supportsInterface (interfaces/IReservationBroker.sol): the ERC-165 ids the broker answers true for, each the XOR of the selectors of every function the interface declares in its own body (type(I).interfaceId), computed over the exported ABIs; the resolver id is what the trustedzones and the intake check a data owner for before reading holderOf and handoverOf, the broker id is the whole surface.
